items.title: Ford (F) Halts F-150 Production at Dearborn Over a Supplier Problem
items.summary: Ford Motor Company (NYSE:F) has stopped building the F-150 at its Dearborn Truck Plant, according to a company memo. All crews were canceled from Thursday through Tuesday, September 29. Some shifts at the Kansas City Assembly plant were affected as well. The cause is a supplier problem rather than weak demand.
